tagline: Condition-aware standing orders for tokenized stocks on X Layer.
_status: PRE-DEPLOYMENT. Fields that are null are not yet true and must not be quoted as if they were.

contracts._status: not yet deployed to mainnet; deploy verified on an X Layer fork

assetProvenance.verificationMethod: symbol(), decimals() and ERC-4626 asset() called on chain 196; a wrapper that does not round-trip to the published underlying is not promoted to SUPPORTED

conditionSources.verification: EIP-712 signature recovered and freshness enforced on chain
conditionSources.honestDescription: operator-attested, not oracle-verified; the signature proves which key asserted which session and when, not that the assertion was correct

conditionSources.verifierProxyConfirmed: typeAndVersion() returns 'VerifierProxy 2.0.0' by direct call on chain 196
conditionSources.reportSchema: v11 RWA Advanced, carries marketStatus uint32
conditionSources.whyUnused: we could not reproduce usable equity-stream delivery and on-chain verification with the feed catalog, credentials and public integration path available in this build; Data Streams access is a paid subscription we did not purchase. This is a limit of our reproduction attempt and is NOT a claim that the streams are absent or unprovisioned for X Layer.

headlineClaim: Bespeak took a funded tokenized-stock instruction, waited until the user's recorded market condition was satisfied, executed the bounded order on X Layer, and independently verified the expected asset delivery and vault state.
headlineClaimStatus: NOT YET PROVEN — requires the canonical mainnet run
supportingBoundaryClaim: When the condition, asset state, route, source freshness or user limits were not satisfied, Bespeak preserved the order and the capital instead of executing outside the user's envelope.
supportingBoundaryClaimStatus: PROVEN in the campaign; see evidence/campaign.json

measured.note: deploy gas measured on an X Layer mainnet fork; execution gas from the test suite

limitations: The market-session condition source is Tier 3 operator-attested, not oracle-verified.
No external security audit. 52 tests including fuzzed accounting invariants and a mainnet-fork suite is not an audit.
The keeper is a single operator and admin is a single EOA; neither is a multisig.
No mainnet execution has occurred yet, so the headline claim is unproven.
No adoption or traction is claimed. Test wallets are not users.
Supported assets are 12 of the issuer's 1026-asset catalogue, restricted to those with a verified deployment.
